test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 8(1)/(2) years at the rate of 3.2% per annum is Rs. 2,550. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 9.6% per annum simple interest in 5(4)/(5) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest for 8½ years at 3.2% = 2,550

Time1 = 8(1)/(2) = 17/2 years

Rate1 = 3.2%

Rate2 = 9.6%

Time2 = 5(4)/(5) = 29/5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI1 = (P × 3.2 × 17/2) ÷ 10
